questions.statement: In which room do you cook food?
questions.context: En una casa de Bogotá, la mamá de Julián prepara arepas para el desayuno.

options.feedback: Incorrect. The bedroom is the room where we sleep, not where we cook.
Correct. The kitchen is the room of the house where we cook food like arepas.
Incorrect. The bathroom is for washing and taking a shower, not for cooking.
Incorrect. The garden is outside the house, with plants and grass, and it has no stove for cooking.

questions.explanation: La palabra "kitchen" significa cocina, el lugar de la casa donde se prepara la comida. Por eso, cuando la mamá de Julián hace arepas, ella está en la "kitchen".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Valeria is very tired. She goes to sleep. Which room does she go to?
questions.context: Son las 8:30 de la noche en Tunja y Valeria se va a dormir porque mañana tiene colegio.

options.feedback: Incorrect. The kitchen is for cooking food, and Valeria wants to sleep.
Incorrect. The dining room is where the family eats meals, not where we sleep.
Correct. The bedroom is the room for sleeping, so a tired child goes there.
Incorrect. The garden is an outside area with plants, and we do not sleep there at night.

questions.explanation: "Bedroom" significa habitación o dormitorio. La palabra viene de "bed" (cama) + "room" (cuarto): el cuarto de la cama. Cuando estamos cansados y vamos a dormir, vamos al "bedroom".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: "Diego takes a shower in the ______."
questions.context: En Barranquilla hace mucho calor y Diego se baña con agua fría al volver del colegio.

options.feedback: Correct. The bathroom has the shower, so it is the room where we wash our body.
Incorrect. The living room is where the family rests and talks, and it has no shower.
Incorrect. The kitchen is for cooking, so we do not take a shower there.
Incorrect. The dining room is for eating meals, and taking a shower happens in another room.

questions.explanation: "Take a shower" significa ducharse o bañarse. Esto lo hacemos en el "bathroom" (baño). Las demás habitaciones tienen otros usos: la cocina para cocinar, la sala para descansar y el comedor para comer.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: "On Sundays, my family eats lunch together in the ______."
questions.context: Los domingos la familia de Natalia, en Bogotá, almuerza ajiaco toda junta alrededor de la mesa.

options.feedback: Incorrect. The bathroom is for washing, so a family lunch does not happen there.
Correct. The dining room is the room where the family sits at the table to eat meals together.
Incorrect. The bedroom is for sleeping and resting, not for a family lunch at the table.
Incorrect. A garage is the place where we keep the car, and families do not eat lunch there.

questions.explanation: "Dining room" significa comedor. "Dine" quiere decir comer una comida principal, y "room" es cuarto. Por eso, cuando la familia almuerza ajiaco junta en la mesa, está en el "dining room".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Mom: "Where is Tomas?"
Dad: "He is in the ______. He is watering the plants and playing with the dog."
questions.context: En una casa con matas y un perro en Armenia, la familia busca a Tomas a la hora de la comida.

options.feedback: Incorrect. The bathroom has a shower and a toilet, not plants for watering and space for a dog to play.
Incorrect. The bedroom is for sleeping, and the clue about watering plants points to an outside area.
Incorrect. The kitchen is for cooking, and the dialog talks about plants and playing outside.
Correct. The garden is the outside area with plants, so Tomas can water them and play with the dog there.

questions.explanation: Las pistas son "watering the plants" (regando las plantas) y "playing with the dog" (jugando con el perro). Esas actividades se hacen afuera, en el "garden" (jardín), que es la parte de la casa con plantas y pasto.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read: "My new apartment has two bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom and a living room. In the living room we watch TV and talk."
Where does the family watch TV?
questions.context: Una niña de Pereira describe su apartamento nuevo en una carta para su prima.

options.feedback: Incorrect. The text mentions the kitchen as one of the rooms, but it does not say they watch TV there.
Incorrect. The text lists two bedrooms but says TV time happens in another room.
Incorrect. The bathroom is in the list of rooms, but the text links TV only to the living room.
Correct. The text says "In the living room we watch TV and talk".

questions.explanation: El texto nombra varias habitaciones, pero solo una oración habla de la televisión: "In the living room we watch TV and talk". "Living room" significa sala, el lugar donde la familia descansa, conversa y ve televisión.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: En una clase de inglés en Florencia, los niños juzgan si cada actividad ocurre en el lugar correcto de la casa.

options.text: I wash my face in the bathroom.
options.feedback: Correct. The bathroom has a sink with water, so washing your face there makes sense.
Incorrect. The kitchen is for cooking; people sleep in the bedroom.

options.text: I take a shower in the dining room.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The dining room is for eating meals, and the shower is in the bathroom.

options.text: I cook rice in the bedroom.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The bedroom is for sleeping, and we cook rice in the kitchen.

questions.explanation: Cada habitación tiene su uso. En el "bathroom" (baño) nos lavamos la cara, en el "bedroom" dormimos, en la "kitchen" cocinamos y en el "dining room" comemos. Solo la oración A une una actividad con la habitación que le corresponde.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read: "Laura wakes up in her bedroom. Then she has breakfast with her family in the kitchen. After school, she reads a book in the patio."
Which sentence is true?
questions.context: Laura vive en una casa colonial de Cartagena con un patio interior lleno de plantas.

options.text: Laura has breakfast in the bathroom.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The text says breakfast is "in the kitchen", and the bathroom does not appear in the text.
Incorrect. The text says she reads "in the patio"; the bedroom is where she wakes up.

options.text: Laura has breakfast in the kitchen.
options.feedback: Correct. The text says "she has breakfast with her family in the kitchen".

options.text: Laura wakes up in the patio.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The text says she wakes up "in her bedroom"; the patio is where she reads.

questions.explanation: El texto cuenta tres momentos del día de Laura y en qué lugar ocurre cada uno: se despierta en el "bedroom", desayuna en la "kitchen" y lee en el "patio". Hay que emparejar bien cada actividad con su lugar; solo la opción C lo hace.
questions.subject: ingles
